remarks: Extraordinary traditional home on one of Orchard Park's most sought after streets. Amazing family room across rear of house with high ceilings, hardwood flooring, two built-in window seats, gas fireplace & sliders to a lovely stamped concrete patio. Open, bright white, granite, fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar, breakfast room and hardwood floor. Spacious formal dining room with pellet stove & French doors to foyer. Very unique Pub room (living room) with custom mahogany paneling, pegged hardwood floors, WBFP, beamed ceiling, built-in bookshelves, wet bar with three refrigerators & dishwasher. A very special place for entertaining! This room also has sliders to a 19x12 sunroom overlooking a beautiful parklike yard. Huge mudroom with a triple closet ( 2) 1/2 baths, a separate gym/exercise room round out the 1st floor. Upstairs is an incredible primary suite with a two sided fireplace, wet bar, wine refrigerator and walk-in closet. Stunning primary bath with double vanity, jetted tub, separate shower, & fireplace. Four more bedrooms, (5th bedroom serves as multi-purpose 2nd floor laundry room & extra guest room), and two more full baths on this level. Finished media room in basement with projector and 15' screen. This home is situated on an over 3/4 acre parklike lot. It has been beautifully maintained and has a lot to offer. Don't miss this gem!
